name: Aadhaar Enrolment
summary: How to enrol for Aadhaar at an authorised Aadhaar Enrolment Centre: fill in the enrolment form, have your demographic and biometric data captured, submit proof of identity and proof of address documents (or enrol through the head of family), and collect the acknowledgement slip with your Enrolment ID. Aadhaar enrolment is free of cost, and you need to enrol only once.
eligibility: Enrol with one valid Proof of Identity (PoI) document and one valid Proof of Address (PoA) document. If you do not have individual valid documents, you can still enrol if your name is in a family entitlement document: the Head of Family named in it must first be enrolled with valid PoI and PoA documents, and can then introduce you with documents that establish the Proof of Relationship (PoR). Enrol only once: multiple enrolments result in rejection unless advised by UIDAI.
steps: Go to any authorised Aadhaar Enrolment Centre or Aadhaar Camp near you, anywhere in India, with your proof of identity and proof of address documents. Aadhaar enrolment is free of cost.
Have your demographic and biometric data captured.

Submit your proof of identity and proof of address documents. Common proofs are the election photo ID card, ration card, passport and driving licence; UIDAI's list of supporting documents gives every accepted document. Under the Head of Family approach, the enrolled head of family introduces you instead, with documents that establish the Proof of Relationship.
Collect the acknowledgement slip containing your Enrolment ID.
The waiting time for Aadhaar is 180 days after receipt of the enrolment data packets in CIDR.
